ex.t: 我想专注于我的乐队，毕业后从事音乐事业。

ex.t: B：她正坐在池塘边的长凳上。

defs.def: a group of musicians who play brass and percussion instruments 管乐队；鼓号乐队
a group of people who do sth together or who have the same ideas 一伙人；一帮人
a thin flat strip or circle of any material that is put around things, for example to hold them together or to make them stronger 带；箍

ex.s: It also has a voice control setting that enables you to stay hands-free, while its waterproof band is fully adjustable so that it is comfortable to wear.
ex.t: 它还带有语音控制设置，让你无需动手，而其防水的表带可完全调节，佩戴舒适。

defs.def: a strip of colour or material on sth that is different from what is around it 条纹；条饰

ex.s: What does Levine want to explain by mentioning the rubber band?
ex.t: Levine提到橡皮筋想要解释什么？

defs.def: a range of radio waves 频带；波段
a range of numbers, ages, prices, etc. within which people or things are counted or measured （数目、年龄、价格等的）范围，段
to put a band of a different colour or material around sth 加彩条（或嵌条等）
to be organized into bands of price, income, etc. （将价格、收入等）划分档次，分等级
